signout_confirm: Do you want to sign out?
contact_introduction:
We will check your email and reply within 18 hours.
However, we don't respond to promotions or spam.
contact_limit_rate_over_notice: For security reasons, there is a limit to the number of times you can send your message. Please try again in an hour.
contact_category_help_notice: If you have any questions, we will explain until you find a solution.
contact_category_violation_label: Report the violating book or user
contact_category_violation_notice:
Please include the URL of the user's profile or book, as well as specific parts.
We will investigate whether the terms of use have been violated and report the results and reasons.
contact_category_copyright_notice:
We are not a US company, so the DMCA does not apply to us.
After we complete the process of verifying that you are a rights holder, we will remove any posts that infringe copyrights.
contact_category_bug_notice: If you can provide us with a detailed description of the browser, device, and steps you took to get this to happen, it will help us identify and fix the problem faster.
contact_category_feature_notice:
We sincerely appreciate and will consider all requests, but it is difficult to accommodate all of them.
We will contact you by email to let you know how we will address each request or why we will not address it.
contact_category_translation_notice:
We use machine translations for most of this service.
So feel free to request them, as we trust you to be right.
contact_category_security_notice:
We take vulnerabilities very seriously. We will deal with them as a top priority.
If you find an undisclosed vulnerability, please provide detailed instructions on how to reproduce it.
If the person who finds the vulnerability has a ShortBook account, we will give you ShortBook points worth $1 to $30 depending on the severity and scope of the impact.
contact_category_policy_notice:
If you have any questions, omissions, or concerns, please let us know.
We do not have a comprehensive knowledge of world laws, so we would appreciate it if you could also let us know the law on which your request is based.
contact_category_company_notice: This is the general contact point for our company.
contact_category_recruit_notice: We are not currently hiring and have no plans to begin recruiting.
contact_category_press_notice:
This category is for members of the press.
We accept inquiries regarding press releases and interviews.
contact_category_life_notice:
We never turn down a life consultation. It's true.
We will present you with articles that are close to your heart and will solve your problems.
Your personal information will be anonymized so you can rest assured about your privacy.
signup_need_agree: By creating an account, you agree to these policies.
signup_mail_introduction:
Thank you for signing up.
Please click this button to finish the process.
signin_mail_introduction:
Hi, {name}!
Thank you for your continued activity.
Please click this button to confirm.
